tw-home-matches.label: Matches at Lucknow in the warehouse
tw-home-matches.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
tw-home-matches.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'other' END v, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) matches, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) rr, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) sixes, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY v

tw-hp.label: Pace economy at Lucknow, 2022–2026
tw-hp.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
tw-hp.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Ekana%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'other' END v, pl.name, SUM((d.total_runs - CASE WHEN d.is_bye = 1 OR d.is_legbye = 1 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END)) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2026 GROUP BY v, pl.name
